BiblicalUsage: Jezliah is named once, in 1 Chronicles 8:18. In 1 Chronicles 8:18 we read, "Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;".
TheologicalSignificance: Jezliah belonged to someone God knew, and I hold that every name in these lists did.
